description: Scott has foughtfor reproductive freedom his entire time in public office because he believes decisions about pregnancy, abortion, and contraception belong to individuals — in consultation with their doctors — not politicians. When the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade and the federal government began actively attacking reproductive health care, Scott responded by fortifying California's defenses — protecting providers, shielding patients, and ensuring the state remained a refuge for people seeking care. In Congress, Scott will fight to protect reproductive freedom in California and across the United States.

title: Scott Wiener for Congress: Reproductive Health & Freedom
